caption: The thank-you screen that a person filling in the published survey sees: Thanks for responding, a line that the answer has been recorded, and the small line Powered by SurvIQ under it. This was the test survey, opened through its own link in the tester tab on the Free plan. The image shows nothing from the account.

The survey editor right after the AI had made the survey: the blue bar The AI added 8 questions. Review and adjust them before publishing., the list of 8 questions on the left (rating, multiple choice, single choice, ratings and, below a new-page marker, a question that starts If you rated your experience below 3), the first question Overall, how would you rate your experience at the Bean Fest with a 1 to 5 scale, and a small product tour box on top. The grey bar at the top of the screen is the cover over the browser bar.

The Results page of the test survey on the Free plan: the AI for your results box, the buttons Filter (Basic), Compare by (Pro), Variables (Basic) and Email report (From Pro), the tabs Simple, Advanced (locked) and Responses, and the numbers 3 responses, 3 views, 100% completion rate and 18s average time. Current plan Free is shown at the bottom left. The grey bar at the top is the cover over the browser bar.

The AI summary of the 3 test answers: it says average event rating 3.7/5 and an NPS of 33, with a note that 3 answers are a small sample; under it the Sentiment of open answers bar shows Positive 0%, Neutral 0%, Negative 100%, and the first main theme Event Logistics and Operations with two quotes of the made-up answers and the highlight that the coffee selection had the highest average at 4.3/5. The grey bar at the top is the cover over the browser bar.
